headlines.title: BA, NOC, RTX Secured Billion-Dollar Deals This Week But One Defense Stock Stole The Limelight – A Look At This Week’s Contracts
headlines.summary: Amentum reported a backlog of $48.3 billion at the end of Q4, while earnings came in at $0.71 per share, beating Wall Street’s estimate of $0.66 per share, according to Fiscal.ai.

headlines.title: Qantas set to award Boeing bulk of 20-jet order, Bloomberg reports
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Qantas Airways is close to selecting Boeing for the bulk of an order for about 20 long-range aircraft, with the Australian carrier also expected to include some Airbus jets, Bloomberg reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Amazon Lost 40 Satellites on a Boeing-Lockheed Rocket in November. SpaceX Is the Only Company That Can Fix Amazon’s Problem. Is the Stock a Buy Near $130?
headlines.summary: The failed launch is a blow to Amazon's plans, but SpaceX isn't going out of its way to help other companies.

headlines.title: Should Space And Submarine Wins Require Action From BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) Investors?
headlines.summary: BAE Systems has been selected to supply its Evolve+ spacecraft bus and lead key roles on NASA's PRIMA far infrared astrophysics mission, while also securing a US$138 million Virginia class submarine propulsor contract and reiterating 2026 sales guidance of +8% to +10% on a constant currency basis.

headlines.title: Why BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) Is Back In The Spotlight
headlines.summary: BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) has just landed a fresh set of space and defense wins, from NASA's PRIMA mission work to a new Virginia-class submarine propulsor contract, alongside reaffirmed 2026 sales guidance. Recent gains from fresh contracts have not stopped some profit taking, with the share price falling 8.6% over the past 30 days and 12.1% over 90 days, even as the year to date share price return sits at 4.9% and the one year total shareholder return is 14.0%.

description: The Boeing Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, services, and supports commercial jetliners, military aircraft, satellites, missile defense, human space flight and launch systems, and services worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Airplanes; Defense, Space & Security; and Global Services. The Commercial Airplanes segment develops, produces, and markets commercial jet aircraft for passenger and cargo requirements. The Defense, Space & Security segment engages in the research, development, production, and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems; strategic defense and intelligence systems, which include strategic missile and defense systems, command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, cyber and information solutions, and intelligence systems; and satellite systems, such as government and commercial satellites, and space exploration. The Global Services segment offers products and services, including supply chain and logistics management, engineering, maintenance and modifications, upgrades and conversions, spare parts, pilot and maintenance training systems and services, technical and maintenance documents, and data analytics and digital services to commercial and defense customers. The Boeing Company was incorporated in 1916 and is based in Arlington, Virginia.
